liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, so cash liquidity covered {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} of revenue, down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}}.
Debt due within one year was reduced by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, which the cash balance alone covers, so near-term maturities do not depend on new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, equal to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, up by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2024}}, as net capex fell by {{net_capex.change@FY2024}} to {{net_capex@FY2024}}.
Fitch rates the group {{rating_fitch@FY2024}} and Moody's {{rating_moodys@FY2024}}, with Moody's having moved the outlook to positive during the year.

watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, leaving cash liquidity to revenue at {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Maturities: debt due within one year of {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}} is covered by the cash balance, but the buffer is thinner than a year earlier, when cash and cash-like investments stood at {{cash_like@FY2023}}.

Interest cover: coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{finance_costs@FY2024}}, though it remains above the peer median of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Tariffs: the CNMC set the maximum adjusted annual revenue per passenger for 2025 at the same level as the prior year, so aeronautical revenue per passenger of {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}} has limited scope to rise through tariffs.
